content:
There's a ton of items available on the gemstore, but not all of them really give you a good quality-of-life or functional boost to your account. When you're spending real money or a lot of gold on these items, it's important to know which ones will give you the best value. Keep in mind that you can buy all of the most impactful items with in-game gold for less than the cost of a legendary weapon. If you don't want to spend real money, you don't have to. This video goes through all of the best items (and the worst too), giving the pros and cons of most major items in the gemstore:
https://youtu.be/rIrtkPwdbFo
